Detecting disruption in federal funding
Nonprofit award disruption, 2025–26

How many active federal awards to nonprofits were disrupted after 20 January 2025, measured against the same window two years earlier.

Disruption on the ledger

What happened administratively to the awards targeted after 20 January 2025: notices, schedule cuts and missing money, against a normal year.

Obligation trends, FY2026

How far FY2026 obligations and new awards to nonprofits fall below their FY2015-2024 trend, by funding agency, mission and region.
